project: Sailor Moon: Another Story (SNES) Static Recompilation
approach: Custom static recompilation into fixed native C bodies preserving exact execution contexts, with a native Windows frontend and target-owned SNES runtime.
notes: Portable Windows 10/11 x64 release 1.0.0 with keyboard and gamepad input, battery saves, snapshots and audio. Requires the exact English v2.08 patched Japan NTSC ROM; ROM and translation patch are not included. Scoped gameplay and ROM-free CI checks are not a complete playthrough certification.
